e: Kyrgyzstan is elected to a rotating seat at the United Nations Security Council.
Former security chief Kamchybek Tashiev and seven others are arrested on charges of planning a coup.
The Kyrgyz Ministry of Emergency Situations says that Kyrgyzstan has dispatched over 100 tons of humanitarian aid to Iran. The shipment is ordered by President Japarov.
Two people are killed and 19 people are injured following a mining incident in Samarkandek, Batken Region.
President Japarov dismisses his ministers for transportation, environment and emergency situations.
